items.title: Ernie Watts interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 11, 2003
items.q: one of the first records he ever loaned me was Dave Brubeck’s “Jazz Goes to College.”

ctx.x: You take the speaker off the front and put it over here. So I got my Silvertone stereo and my mother joined the Columbia Record Club. And she didn’t know. My folks were not music people so they didn’t know about instruments or whatever. But she saw that — she joined the club and the freebie, the first record, was “Kind of Blue.” And so that’s how I got involved with that. And then I had a neighbor that was a jazz fan. My next door neighbor was a jazz fan. And he started to lend me records. So I mean one of the…

When you were doing that, did you get a sense of these guys are improvising first of all, and they’re improvising over a form? Can you recall if you were thinking that? Or were you just like trying to nail what they were playing?
